assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only to-be-hero-x:x@animated-series#15-x-zero-godhood-fate-and-the-limit-of-public-will, the canonical Phase-3 Specialist 15 monograph on X and Zero at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the frozen Mandarin-primary audiovisual first season, and used only for its section-2 'current X as person' (the black-haired office worker who can adopt or refuse the public X presentation); its claims about the X rank as an office, the public X image, Zero, Yan Mo, the Commission and public will are context, not assessed conduct. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and scope only. The episode deep readings, longitudinal ledgers, the X representational-sovereignty ledger, the video and motion audits, the E09/E24 coin-donor audit, the name crosswalk, the project character reconstruction method, any Document 20 model and the episodes themselves are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. No later season, adaptation or supplementary material is included, and the evaluator performed no audiovisual inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: First-season S01E11-E24 as the artifact declares: the E11 tournament result recognized before the bearer is identified, the E20-E21 office and home presentation, the E22 Liang intervention and pendant retrieval, the E23 anonymous help, and the E24 home invasion, pursuit, bar, history-space and tournament entry ending with the clock-out line; plus the E09 coin gift to young Qīng identified only retrospectively through E24's re-staging. Broadcast order is revelation order, not diegetic development; X's legal name, age, origin and how he became X are unestablished, the E24 credits coda is non-diegetic and the final spatiotemporal discontinuity is unresolved. No state after the season's end is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph's person-level thesis is that X practices anti-totalization: he keeps ordinary work, friendship, privacy, refusal and exit so the office does not own the whole self (sections 1, 6, 22, 34-35), with stated self-reports that he does not want a fourth term and wants someone else to take the job (section 8). This is a political and philosophical reading in which X's acts serve as a counter-model to Zero; it supplies no decision rules, priorities or exceptions, and section 35 and 48.3 leave the durability of these habits under trauma, Fear or escalation open, so D is not supported; located argued tendencies exist, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

Section 3 orders X's appearances from E11 to E24, but explicitly as broadcast revelation (deified, then demythologized) rather than development; the one stated change in the person is retrospective self-understanding, from believing his hero path began with the coin to seeing causes already sown (sections 39-41), with the E09 gift identified only in retrospect. No prior state, development or default state is modeled and his origin is a protected question, so D is not supported; the revision of self-narration is located, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

The monograph quotes a few exact Mandarin lines with their functions: 绝不加班 refusing Smile's 换个身份 request (section 22), 来看看 as invitation rather than command (section 26), Zero其实从未泯灭 (section 19), 违抗命运的安排 and the delayed 准点下班 (section 43). There is no register analysis, sentence-ending or lexical inventory, recipient-conditioned variation or acoustic evidence for him in this artifact, so D is not supported; the forms are exact and functionally situated, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

Section 6 lists an office job with schedule and coworkers, ordinary clothes, a home, sleepwear and glasses, irritation at overtime, and section 34 a drink bought for A-Hu at a bar. These are located as the material of his private presentation, but they are listed rather than analyzed as conduct, the habits are not specified and the monograph uses them chiefly for their structural meaning, so D is not supported; located ordinary facts exist, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

Located relations differ: Smile asks the private man to change identity and X can refuse without the relation collapsing, then retrieves Smile's pendant after his death (sections 7, 30); A-Hu receives anonymous help, a drink and the forbidden history in an adversarial trust without friendship or allegiance (sections 29, 37); Liang meets an intervention that changes the encounter's category (section 28); coworkers do not know him; young Qīng receives an unclaimed coin (section 39). Each relation rests on one or two scenes and X's side of most is inferred, so D is not supported; the variation is explicit and located, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

The affirmative material is X's own spoken self-account: he does not want a fourth term and wants someone else to take the job (section 8), and he once believed his hero path began with the coin but now says all causes were already sown (section 39). Nothing in the artifact focalizes him or reconstructs feeling; his motive for anonymity and for disclosure to A-Hu is inferred. D is not supported; the subject's own stated wishes and revised self-narration are located, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

Located conflict: he defeats Queen in E11 without the contest becoming intelligible (section 4), interrupts Liang's damage-return logic by changing the representational category rather than inflicting a larger injury (section 28), and in E24 escapes the home invasion and pursuit by rooftop transition, car and bar rather than counterattacking, explaining rather than enthroning himself (sections 33-34). The monograph calls this evidence of current telos, not permanent benevolence, and supplies no conflict rule or exceptions, so D is not supported; the conduct is located and adjudicated, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

Located ethical stances: he accepts the judgment that Zero's killings were tyranny while restoring his heroic origin (section 12), permits the public misattribution of his help to A-Hu, which the monograph says contributes to causal distortion (section 29), chooses disclosure ('come look') over demanded belief (section 26), and frames defying fate as refusing expected repetition (section 42). Most of the ethical weight is the monograph's constitutional argument rather than shown weighing by X, and section 35 states that his values carry no guarantee, so D is not supported; located stances exist, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

His own play is the refusal 绝不加班 and the delayed 准点下班 punchline after fate language (sections 22, 43), which the monograph reads as both literal joke and philosophical claim; the production-credit overlay is the work's formal rhyme, not his. Two located lines are not a repertoire, so D is not supported; the jokes are his own and located, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

The artifact declares the frozen Mandarin-primary first season with primary close reading of E20-E24, E24 motion audit and E11-E12, plus the E09/E24 coin audit within its still-frame limits, and routes claims to episode readings and audit timestamps (section 48.2). The person is one of two named subjects in a monograph whose object is constitutional structure, the routed readings and audits are outside this evidence set, and section 48.3 lists his name, age, origin and mechanics as unresolved, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits: his anonymity contributes to A-Hu's distorted sole-credit story (section 29); he cannot restore Smile or ease Nice's grief (sections 7, 30); his history-space is authored representation that he selects and frames, not a neutral archive (section 27); the snap is a recurrent cue, not a universal prerequisite (section 22); the coin has no shown mechanism (section 39). These come from one project's adjudication in a single artifact, so D is not supported; they are affirmative located countercases, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

The monograph separates broadcast from diegetic order (section 3), keeps E09's prospective reading standing while identifying the donor retrospectively through E24 (section 39), treats the credits coda as non-diegetic (section 48.5) and leaves the final discontinuity open. It fixes no default state, knowledge state or cutoff for the person, so D is not supported; the explicit chronology bindings are located, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

scenario_readiness.note: Five short quoted lines with functions do not constitute a register model, and the artifact contains no analysis of his Mandarin speech across recipients. CONDITIONAL would license lines that are mostly invention; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the exact located forms that can check a line.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: First-season E20-E24 as analyzed, from the office and home presentation through the E24 tournament entry, with E11 only as an offscreen result and E09 only as a retrospectively identified gift.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Smile as private friend, A-Hu as adversarial confidant, Liang as opponent, unaware coworkers, institutional pursuers and young Qīng as unknowing recipient.

Only the person, not the X office, the public X image or Zero
No complete mechanics, range, cost or reversibility of his representational/world-state power

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph's protected questions (section 48.3) include whether his anti-totalization habits survive trauma, Fear or escalation, and section 35 states that none of his values guarantees future conduct; it supplies no rule set, exceptions or transfer discipline. CONDITIONAL would turn a constitutional reading into behavioral prediction; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the artifact's affirmative refusal to certify durability.

Office, home, sleepwear and a bar drink are located, but no ordinary interaction is analyzed beyond the Smile request and the drink, and no routine or habit is specified. CONDITIONAL would invent workplace and home behavior from a list of props; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located ordinary presentation.

His ethical stances are located but the moral reasoning in the artifact is the monograph's constitutional argument, and section 35 says his self-limitation is bearer-dependent and unguaranteed. CONDITIONAL would attribute that argument to X as a procedure; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located stances.
No romantic relation of X is analyzed in the artifact; this records missing evidence, not an inability.

Both of his jobs are located only in outline: the office job through its schedule and overtime refusal, and the hero role through refusing management, anonymous help and entering the tournament. The monograph leaves how he became X, how he exercises the office and the Commission's procedures open. CONDITIONAL would supply professional conduct the artifact does not analyze; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located refusals and anonymous help.

known_limits.statement: This subject is only the current X as a person; the X rank as an office that can outlast a bearer, the public X image that crowds call god, and Zero are separate entities in the monograph, and claims about them are not conduct of this person.

The artifact's governing object is the political limit of public will and godhood; X's acts are read chiefly as a counter-model to Zero, his practice is called evidence of current telos rather than permanent benevolence, and no decision rules, priorities or exceptions are given for the person.

Season 1 leaves X's legal name, age, origin and complete pre-hero history, how he first became X, and the complete mechanics, range, cost, duration and reversibility of his representational/world-state power unresolved; the snap is a recurrent cue, not a universal law.

The shared history-space through which X shows A-Hu Zero's origin is authored by X, who selects sequence, images and framing; it is strong narrative testimony but not an established neutral archive, and how X knows the history is unestablished.

The E09 coin donor is identified as X only through E24's re-staging; E09 withholds his face, nothing shows Qīng learning who gave it, and no mechanism links the coin to his powers, fate or Qīng's abilities.

Whether his ordinary-life, refusal and exit habits survive future trauma, Fear, political escalation or prolonged office is a protected open question; none of his current values guarantees later conduct.

The episode deep readings, longitudinal ledgers, representational-sovereignty ledger, video and motion audits, the coin-donor audit, the name crosswalk, the project character reconstruction method, any Document 20 model and the audiovisual source are not curated evidence on this subject, so the monograph's timestamps and routes were not rechecked here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
